name: Angkor Wat
_about: ANGKOR WAT (c. 1150): the temple-mountain facing west -- the causeway with its naga balustrades and the ponds, the Terrace of Honour, the outer gallery round its terrace (gopuras on its axes, the western crowned by three towers), the cruciform cloister and its libraries, the second gallery on its platform with its corner towers and libraries, and the bakan climbed by its ladder-steep stairs: the square gallery, the cross of galleries and the quincunx of prangs, the central one sixty-five metres up. The plan the survey's, made symmetric. Generated by tools/archgen/angkor_wat.py -- edit the script for arithmetic changes. East is +x, south +z.
